      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_04</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_NotSatisfied</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorAmountChecked</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100Grams" name="Under 100 grams?" default="Flow_ColorAtLeast100Grams">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorAmountChecked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorUnder100Grams</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorAtLeast100Grams</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAmountInGrams < 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorAtLeast100Grams" name="100 grams or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100Grams" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReady">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAmountInGrams >= 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorUnder100Grams</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShoppingListToProcurement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderPlastic" name="Order plastic">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorNotInStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderToProcurement</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShoppingListToProcurement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderToProcurement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcurementToAvailability</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShoppingListToProcurement" sourceRef="Task_AddToShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_ProcurementMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToProcurement" sourceRef="Task_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Gateway_ProcurementMerge"/>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AvailabilityToReady</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcurementToAvailability" sourceRef="Gateway_ProcurementMerge" targetRef="Event_PlasticAvailable"/>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorAtLeast100Grams</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AvailabilityToReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorReadyToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorReadyToSplit</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToGenerateGcode</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToPrinterPreparation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TurnOnToHeatBed</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TurnOnToHeatBed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HeatBedToExtruder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatExtruder" name="Heat the extruder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HeatBedToExtruder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HeatingToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPrinterPreparation" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TurnOnToHeatBed" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Task_HeatBed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HeatBedToExtruder" sourceRef="Task_HeatBed" targetRef="Task_HeatExtruder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HeatingToJoin" sourceRef="Task_HeatExtruder" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToGenerateGcode</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GcodeToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToGenerateGcode" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GcodeToJoin" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Printer ready and G-code generated">

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GcodeToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToPrint</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToPrint" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print the model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToPrint</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrintToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrintToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="Event_CustomerEnd"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_CustomerEnd" name="Model printed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrintToEnd</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_PrinterStatus" name="Receive ongoing printer status" triggeredByEvent="true">

        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceivePrinterStatus" name="Receive printer status">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StatusStartToReceive</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StatusReceiveToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusStartToReceive" sourceRef="Event_PrinterStatusStart" targetRef="Task_ReceivePrinterStatus"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_PrinterStatusEnd" name="Status received">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StatusReceiveToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusReceiveToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePrinterStatus" targetRef="Event_PrinterStatusEnd"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
  </bpmn:process>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSTL" name="Send the STL model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Artist_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Artist_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Artist_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ArtistChanges" name="Are changes requested?" default="Flow_Artist_Accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Artist_05</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_01" sourceRef="Event_ArtistStart" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_08" sourceRef="Task_ReviseProject" targetRef="Task_SendSTL"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrinterStart_TurnOn</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TurnOn_Heat</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatBedAndExtruder" name="Heat the bed and the extruder">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TurnOn_Heat</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Heat_PrinterPreparationEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_PrinterPreparationEnd" name="Printer heated">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Heat_PrinterPreparationEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrinterStart_TurnOn" sourceRef="Event_PrinterPreparationStart" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TurnOn_Heat" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Task_HeatBedAndExtruder"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Heat_PrinterPreparationEnd" sourceRef="Task_HeatBedAndExtruder" targetRef="Event_PrinterPreparationEnd"/>
      <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_PrinterStatus" name="Receive ongoing printer status" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_PrinterStatusStart" name="Printer sends status" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StatusStart_StatusEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_PrinterStatusEnd" name="Status received">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StatusStart_StatusEnd</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusStart_StatusEnd" sourceRef="Event_PrinterStatusStart" targetRef="Event_PrinterStatusEnd"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate G-code from the artist's STL">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToGenerateGcode</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Gcode_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Printer heated and G-code generated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrinterPreparation_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Gcode_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_Print</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print the model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_Print</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Print_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_CustomerEnd" name="Model printed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Print_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerStart_Instruct" sourceRef="Event_CustomerStart" targetRef="Task_InstructArtist"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Instruct_SendSketches" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sketches_ReceiveSTL" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveSTL_Satisfaction" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfied_ChooseColor" name="Satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfiedWithResult</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotSatisfied_SendChanges" name="Changes needed" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not satisfiedWithResult</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Changes_ReceiveSTL" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseColor_InStock" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorInStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock_CheckAmount" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInStock_Order" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Task_OrderPlastic">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not colorInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAmount_Under100" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under100_ShoppingList" name="Under 100 grams" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAmountInGrams < 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AtLeast100_ColorReady" name="100 grams or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReady">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAmountInGrams >= 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShoppingList_ColorReady" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_WaitPlastic" sourceRef="Task_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Event_PlasticAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlasticAvailable_ColorReady" sourceRef="Event_PlasticAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorReady_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorReady" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPrinterPreparation" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_PrinterPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToGenerateGcode" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrinterPreparation_Join" sourceRef="SubProcess_PrinterPreparation" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gcode_Join" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Print" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Print_End" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="Event_CustomerEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create and revise the 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_ArtistStart" name="Receive project instructions">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArtistStart_ReceiveSketches</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_ProjectInstructions"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ArtistReceiveSketches" name="Receive sketches">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArtistStart_ReceiveSketches</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArtistSketches_Create</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProject" name="Create the project">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArtistSketches_Create</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Create_SendInitialSTL</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInitialSTL" name="Send the STL model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Create_SendInitialSTL</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InitialSTL_ArtistEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_ArtistInitialEnd" name="Initial STL sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InitialSTL_ArtistEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_ArtistRevisionStart" name="Receive requested changes">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RevisionStart_Revise</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviseProject" name="Revise the project">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RevisionStart_Revise</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Revise_SendSTL</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRevisedSTL" name="Send the revised STL model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Revise_SendSTL</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RevisedSTL_ArtistEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_ArtistRevisionEnd" name="Revised STL sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RevisedSTL_ArtistEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArtistStart_ReceiveSketches" sourceRef="Event_ArtistStart" targetRef="Task_ArtistReceiveSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArtistSketches_Create" sourceRef="Task_ArtistReceiveSketches" targetRef="Task_CreateProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Create_SendInitialSTL" sourceRef="Task_CreateProject" targetRef="Task_SendInitialSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialSTL_ArtistEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialSTL" targetRef="Event_ArtistInitialEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RevisionStart_Revise" sourceRef="Event_ArtistRevisionStart" targetRef="Task_ReviseProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Revise_SendSTL" sourceRef="Task_ReviseProject" targetRef="Task_SendRevisedSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RevisedSTL_ArtistEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendRevisedSTL" targetRef="Event_ArtistRevisionEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/artist-3d-print">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Instructions" name="Project instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="STL model"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Changes" name="Requested changes"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DModel">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="You" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist" processRef="Process_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Instructions" name="Project instructions" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Event_ArtistInstructions" messageRef="Message_Instructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ArtistReceiveSketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL" name="STL model" sourceRef="Task_SendSTL" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" name="Requested changes" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Event_ArtistChanges" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Event_PrinterStatusStart" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist and print a 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_CustomerStart" name="Want a custom 3D model">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InstructArtist" name="Instruct the artist to create a project" messageRef="Message_Instructions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSTL" name="Receive the STL model" messageRef="Message_STL">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_ChangesToResult</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewResult" name="Review the result">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with the result?" default="Flow_Customer_NotSatisfied">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Satisfied</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_NotSatisfied</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell the artist what to change" messageRef="Message_Changes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_NotSatisfied</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_ChangesToResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Satisfied</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorInStock" name="Color in stock?" default="Flow_ColorNotInStock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorInStock</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorNotInStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckColorAmount" name="Check how much color is left">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorInStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorAmountChecked</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100Grams" name="Under 100 grams?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorAmountChecked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorUnder100Grams</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorAtLeast100Grams</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddToShoppingList" name="Put color on the shopping list">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorUnder100Grams</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShoppingListToProcurement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderPlastic" name="Order plastic">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorNotInStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderToProcurement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProcurementMerge" name="Continue after shopping-list or order route">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShoppingListToProcurement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderToProcurement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcurementToAvailability</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PlasticAvailable" name="Plastic available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcurementToAvailability</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AvailabilityToReady</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">plasticAvailable</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorReady" name="Plastic ready to use">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorAtLeast100Grams</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AvailabilityToReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorReadyToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare printer and generate G-code">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorReadyToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToPrinterPreparation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToGenerateGcode</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TurnOnPrinter" name="Turn on the printer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToPrinterPreparation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TurnOnToHeatBed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatBed" name="Heat the bed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TurnOnToHeatBed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HeatBedToExtruder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatExtruder" name="Heat the extruder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HeatBedToExtruder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HeatingToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate G-code from the STL">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToGenerateGcode</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GcodeToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Printer preparation and G-code complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HeatingToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GcodeToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToPrint</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print the model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToPrint</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrintToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_CustomerEnd" name="Model printed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrintToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_PrinterStatus" name="Receive ongoing printer status" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_PrinterStatusStart" name="Printer sends status" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StatusStartToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_PrinterStatusEnd" name="Status received">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StatusStartToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusStartToEnd" sourceRef="Event_PrinterStatusStart" targetRef="Event_PrinterStatusEnd"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_01" sourceRef="Event_CustomerStart" targetRef="Task_InstructArtist"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_02" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_03" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Task_ReviewResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_05" sourceRef="Task_ReviewResult" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Satisfied" name="Satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfiedWithResult</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_NotSatisfied" name="Changes needed" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_ChangesToResult" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_06" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorInStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorInStock" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Task_CheckColorAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorNotInStock" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Task_OrderPlastic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorAmountChecked" sourceRef="Task_CheckColorAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Under100Grams"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorUnder100Grams" name="Under 100 grams" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100Grams" targetRef="Task_AddToShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAmountInGrams < 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorAtLeast100Grams" name="100 grams or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100Grams" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReady">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAmountInGrams >= 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShoppingListToProcurement" sourceRef="Task_AddToShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_ProcurementMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToProcurement" sourceRef="Task_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Gateway_ProcurementMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcurementToAvailability" sourceRef="Gateway_ProcurementMerge" targetRef="Event_PlasticAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AvailabilityToReady" sourceRef="Event_PlasticAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorReadyToSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorReady" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPrinterPreparation" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TurnOnToHeatBed" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Task_HeatBed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HeatBedToExtruder" sourceRef="Task_HeatBed" targetRef="Task_HeatExtruder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HeatingToJoin" sourceRef="Task_HeatExtruder" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToGenerateGcode" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GcodeToJoin" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToPrint" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrintToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="Event_CustomerEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create and revise the 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_ArtistInstructions" name="Receive project instructions">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_Instructions"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Artist_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ArtistReceiveSketches" name="Receive sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Artist_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Artist_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProject" name="Create the project">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Artist_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Artist_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviseProject" name="Revise the project">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Artist_Changes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Artist_04</bpmn:outgoing>
